title: Oatcakes with ricotta and cherry tomatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, flour, butter, ricotta, tomatoes and balsamic are all plain kitchen staples with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a baking tray and an oven, and pressing out and cutting oatcakes suits a beginner.

works.reason: The oats, flour, butter and hot water ratio makes a workable oatcake dough, and 12 oatcakes with 200g ricotta and 250g tomatoes is a sensible snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers mixing, pressing out, cutting and halving tomatoes, and the 25-minute cook matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fresh cherry tomatoes with basil are named in the title and make a light, summery topping that suits early June.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholegrain oatcakes with ricotta and fresh tomatoes make a filling snack of real food.
